title: Re-run Run C with corrected OllamaJudge (think-block stripping fix)
summary: The OllamaJudge fix for <think> block mis-parsing has landed in code but Run C's 62.0% score was produced pre-fix. Re-run and remove the 're-run' caveat from BENCHMARKS.md.
description:
Run C in BENCHMARKS.md was produced while OllamaJudge still mis-parsed <think> reasoning blocks as part of the verdict (deepseek-r1:8b score 62.0%). The fix has since landed in benchmarks/common/llm_judge.py. Re-run scripts/run_benchmarks.py --suite retrieval --judge ollama:deepseek-r1:8b against the same Run C configuration (no-SDK baseline) and update BENCHMARKS.md's Run C section and summary table, removing the '(pre-fix — re-run)' caveat. Requires local Ollama daemon with deepseek-r1:8b pulled and a live Db2 instance.

**Status: Abandoned** — EPIC-13's BM-2 will delete scripts/run_benchmarks.py, benchmarks/common/llm_judge.py, and benchmarks/retrieval_quality/dataset.py as part of the harness retirement. This story depends on exactly those three modules. Rather than executing a run against a harness that is being retired, this story is explicitly abandoned: the Run C corrected measurement will be captured under EPIC-16 (BM-16), which rewrites the retrieval quality suite against the real LongMemEval dataset. The '(pre-fix — re-run)' caveat is acknowledged debt that EPIC-16 retires entirely by switching to a deterministic IR metric rather than an LLM judge. Abandoned in favour of EPIC-16.

comments.text: Explicitly abandoned to unblock EPIC-13 BM-2. The old harness (scripts/run_benchmarks.py + llm_judge.py + dataset.py) will be deleted by BM-2. Re-measurement of Run C is subsumed by EPIC-16's full retrieval-quality rewrite on the real LongMemEval dataset. Abandonment recorded here per the cross-epic gate in BM-2's story description.
